summary.text: Hanna Gallo is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 27 since 1999 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hanna Gallo attended the Community College of Rhode Island in 1976 and earned a B.S. in communicative disorders from the University of Rhode Island in 1995 and an M.S. in speech language in 1997.
Her professional experience includes working as a speech language pathologist for the South Kingstown School Department.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
